CustomField.description: Which data operations this integration performs on the object: Create, Read, Update, Delete, and/or Upsert. More than one value can be selected, for example an integration that both Reads and Updates records. An integration that only Reads cannot be broken by a field deletion in the same way a Create or Update integration can, so this field is important context when weighing the risk of a proposed change.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which data operations this integration performs on the object.
CustomField.label: Operation
